title: Remember the Lord

questions.question: Why did God lead Israel in the wilderness for 40 years?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:2 (ESV): "...that he might humble you, testing you to know what was in your heart..."

questions.question: What does man live by, if not bread alone?
options: Every word that comes from the mouth of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Every word that comes from the mouth of the Lord
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:3 (ESV): "...that he might make you know that man does not live by bread alone, but man lives by every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD."

questions.question: What happened to their clothing during the 40 years?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:4 (ESV): "Your clothing did not wear out on you and your foot did not swell these forty years."

questions.question: What is the danger when they have eaten and are full?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:11–14 (ESV): "Take care lest you forget the LORD... when you have eaten and are full... then your heart be lifted up..."

questions.question: Who gives power to get wealth?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:18 (ESV): "You shall remember the LORD your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth..."

questions.question: What kind of land is described in verse 8?
options: A land of wheat and barley, vines and fig trees
A land of milk and honey only
questions.correctAnswer: A land of wheat and barley, vines and fig trees
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:8 (ESV): "a land of wheat and barley, of vines and fig trees and pomegranates, a land of olive trees and honey..."

questions.question: What minerals are found in the land?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:9 (ESV): "...a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you can dig copper."

questions.question: How does a man discipline his son, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:5 (ESV): "Know then in your heart that, as a man disciplines his son, the Lord your God disciplines you."

questions.question: From what did God bring water in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:15 (ESV): "...who brought you water out of the flinty rock..."

questions.question: What creatures were in the terrifying wilderness?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:15 (ESV): "...who led you through the great and terrifying wilderness, with its fiery serpents and scorpions..."

questions.question: What false thought might one say in their heart?
options: "My power and the might of my hand have gotten me this wealth."
questions.correctAnswer: "My power and the might of my hand have gotten me this wealth."
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:17 (ESV): "Beware lest you say in your heart, 'My power and the might of my hand have gotten me this wealth.'"

questions.question: If they forget God and follow other gods, what is the consequence?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:19 (ESV): "...I solemnly warn you today that you shall surely perish."

questions.question: Why does God destroy the nations before them?
options: Because they would not obey the voice of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Because they would not obey the voice of the Lord
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:20 (ESV): "Like the nations that the Lord makes to perish before you, so shall you perish, because you would not obey the voice of the Lord your God."

questions.question: What food did their fathers not know?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:16 (ESV): "who fed you in the wilderness with manna that your fathers did not know..."

questions.question: Besides clothing not wearing out, what else happened physically?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 8:4 (ESV): "...and your foot did not swell these forty years."

key_verse_text: And he humbled you and let you hunger and fed you with manna, which you did not know, nor did your fathers know, that he might make you know that man does not live by bread alone, but man lives by every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD. (ESV)
